_about: MR. MAS Ep1 ElevenLabs cast (track A4, pass v3-voices-el, 2026-09-27). Every voice is a LIBRARY voice (an ElevenLabs premade voice, or a shared Voice Library voice called by voice_id): no instant or professional cloning, no voice design, no reference audio of anyone. No voice was chosen for resembling a real person. The screen (tools/cast_el.py) removed every library voice whose name or description names or evokes a real person, a celebrity, an impression, a real assistant product, an accent or an age/health register before ranking. Picks are from the briefs in audio/voices/CASTING.md, cast_a4.py and the character files, by measurement: nobody has listened. Set A = every role's candidate A; set B = candidate B for the six principals (Mas, Gerg, Alyi, Rima, Neleh, Tasya) and A for everyone else.
model_note: eleven_multilingual_v2 is the model for every role. eleven_v3 was tested and not used for this pass (see voices-el.md, 'Model'): on short single lines it ran fast and cut tails, and it has no speed control.
respell_note: names as the house lexicon (cast.json 'lexicon', naming.md §9) says them, respelled for the voice: Mas /mɑs/ -> 'Moss', Gerg /ɡɜɹɡ/ -> 'Gurg', Alyi /ˈælji/ -> 'Al-yee'. Only the text sent changes; lines JSON keep the script's text.
